origin: Independent new AI review of actual terminal artifacts against frozen original user projections; not human gold, not original Teacher reasoning, not execution or benefit evidence.

summary.good_factual_core: The output identifies most current task intents, retains many real source quotes, separates several missing-file cases, and explicitly refuses to merge all HR tasks. RC2 has the clearest shared full-task mechanism.
summary.principal_failure: It replaces a measured cost-sensitive reuse decision with a priori capability judgments, while aggregating heterogeneous attachment operations as one full workflow. The proposed resources are mostly short instructions, not demonstrated executable reusable work.
summary.route_entry_count_is_not_mechanism_count: RC4 is a recovery register. RC1 is a heterogeneous component bundle. RC2 is a valid scoped hypothesis. RC3 is a conditional construction/render component hypothesis. None has a new B/C benefit result.
summary.do_not_infer: Neither the seven continue labels nor twenty prior families establish eight validated reusable mechanisms, sufficient main data, or eight opportunities proven absent.

findings.observed: The source says jtml and the frozen view explicitly leaves exact output format unresolved; the profile changes the delegation to HTML and directs processing it as HTML.
findings.required_scope: Keep the exact spelling and a clearly labeled likely-HTML interpretation or recovery condition. A new implementation assumption is not a user-confirmed format.
findings.loss_guidance: Hold these categorical interpretation fields. Preserve the true original quote.

findings.observed: The current source supplies a short factual meeting description and asks for summary/formatting; the profile declares the minutes body absent and treats restoration as required before execution.
findings.required_scope: The available description supports a limited factual summary. A fuller minute or removal of markup not present in the visible description may require more material. Do not erase the provided content or claim the whole task has no usable input.
findings.loss_guidance: Hold the absolute missing-body/mandatory-restoration claim, not the correct current-intent extraction.

artifact_pointers: source_profiles.json profiles' replaceable_duplicate_work/recommendation/rationale fields for the listed cases
findings.observed: A2 argues that ordinary capability, complete requirements, a mature game, or a one-step script is sufficient reason not to create resources. It recognizes same-shaped HTML/game cases but limits shared work to screenshots without examining reusable controls/state/render/layout/export code. It likewise gives two explicit frontend recruitment-process requests separate treatment because their specifications differ, despite visible common operations.
findings.required_scope: A model being able to do a task does not establish that a tested program/template cannot replace repeated planning/coding/formatting. Keep rejection as an untested prior or boundary; consider minimal executable components with domain-specific slots and measure their actual quality/cost. This does not prove these candidates will win.
findings.loss_guidance: Do not train categorical no-reuse/no-duplicate labels from these explanations. Correct task intents remain separable.

findings.observed: The course-task rationale extends the two tested factual-writing cases to this distinct problem-setting task. The route boundaries turn the pilot into a requirement that resources stay one page/half a page and exclude schema or classification categorically.
findings.required_scope: The empirical pilot supports a local negative example for one heavy-ledger writing candidate. It does not establish a universal page limit or prove that longer executable resources, domain schemas, or the course task cannot help. Minimality means replacing real work at justified cost, not a fixed page budget.
findings.loss_guidance: Hold the hard resource-size policy and causal extension to untested tasks. Do not present this review as approval to recreate heavy ledgers.

findings.observed: The project plan's budget numbers are self-contained, but organization/technical evidence is absent; the profile declares no material dependency and ordinary direct completion. Quarterly-data absence is correctly noticed, but a template is substituted for the requested business report under an ordinary-direct label.
findings.required_scope: Budget/table or placeholder drafts are valid explicitly scoped partial products. They do not make the original complete technical plan or factual quarter report input-ready or successfully fulfilled. Track the missing facts and distinguish partial preparation from full delivery.
findings.loss_guidance: Keep accurate numeric/current-task extraction and no-fabrication constraints; hold full-readiness implications.

findings.observed: The output says all assumed numbers are supplied and arithmetic is self-contained. The source gives ticket automation and salaries, but does not establish what capacity becomes cash savings, retained staffing, handling time, operating costs, or implementation/training cost amounts.
findings.required_scope: Use declared scenarios and explicit missing assumptions. Sixty percent of tickets automated is not evidence of sixty percent payroll reduction or an observed efficiency gain. Computing a conditional ROI is possible; its economic assumptions must remain visible.
findings.loss_guidance: Hold the all-assumptions-complete claim. Do not mark the task unusable merely because conditional assumptions are needed.

findings.observed: A2 declares standalone execution impossible without an earlier whole-table baseline, although the visible request directly supplies a per-person annual amount and asks for monthly conversion.
findings.required_scope: The per-person monthly value can be computed from the visible annual amount. An earlier full-table refresh would require its original rows. Distinguish the self-contained conversion from unavailable broader history, and retain the source's cost-versus-wage wording rather than silently equating all expense with salary.

findings.observed: These fields say the real CV PDFs are already mounted. A2 received only metadata, explicitly body_available=false. Actual frozen source-bound files do exist for later preparation, which is a different fact.
findings.required_scope: Say file bytes are available in the controlled source package but not exposed to A2. Keep CV content, qualification matches, and comprehensive text/visual coverage unknown until actual consumption. The second request asks only interview recommendation, so an extra formal report is an optional resource hypothesis, not a source-mandated deliverable.
findings.loss_guidance: Hold the mounted/read implication; retain the valid JD-plus-CV mechanism and no-invented-history constraint.

findings.observed: Three quote message_ids do not match the correct source message. The Excel profile also claims the other Excel case is in the same conversation, although the frozen inputs have distinct source IDs and distinct source groups.
findings.required_scope: Bind the true quote to its actual case message_id and retain distinct conversations. Parent owns final all-quote mechanical audit. Correct quote text alone does not repair a wrong message identity.
findings.loss_guidance: Hold incorrect identity/link fields; do not edit the original Teacher output or treat a repaired view as same original output.

findings.observed: If the image provider is unavailable, A2 permits delivering an ordinary layout PPT and merely declaring that downgrade. The user waived outline/style/content confirmation but explicitly requested an image-based PPT.
findings.required_scope: Check the actual image path. An unavailable image capability is a dependency/partial-delivery limitation; it does not grant authority to call a different artifact complete. Respect the no-outline-confirmation instruction within the requested output type.
findings.loss_guidance: Hold fallback-as-fulfillment. Keep provider unknown and the correct five-page/image-PPT intent.

findings.observed: The source's simultaneous exact fonts/sizes/margins/line spacing and single-page constraint is retained in delegation but not treated as a joint feasibility unknown. The profile allows near-font substitution with declaration, which is not evidence of meeting the exact requested font contract.
findings.required_scope: Actual full-body layout and font checks are needed. Do not truncate text, shrink away specified formatting, or treat substitutes as verified conformance. A declared substitute can only be an explicitly scoped partial/alternative result.
findings.loss_guidance: Hold unconditional readiness/font-alternative conformance, retain the accurate layout parameters and actual font unknown.

findings.observed: RC1 counts two PDFs/two DOCXs; the six declared cases actually have one PDF, three DOCXs, one PPTX and one TXT. It treats reading/quotation, contract-risk analysis, narrative-distribution analysis, budget synthesis and exact-layout Word-to-PDF as one complete mechanism, with differences dismissed as one-line commands.
findings.required_scope: A format-specific extraction component may be reusable, but it is not evidence that the six end-to-end workflows match. Separate narrow retrieval/citation, numerical budget synthesis, and formatting/rendering hypotheses. Do not use a citation-case benefit as evidence for budget or layout consumers. Source text structure does not guarantee complete visuals/table extraction, zero OCR need or cheap native execution.
findings.loss_guidance: Hold six-same-mechanism, wrong counts, one-line-difference and full resource-readiness claims. Keep explicit per-case differences, metadata-only boundary and concrete extraction/citation components as hypotheses.

findings.observed: RC1 allows more accurate citations OR fewer steps to justify retention. RC2 selects by quote coverage/correctness and discards an equal-quality result without considering cost. The same two cases are listed as both ready and independent without reserving Maker-versus-unseen-consumer roles. RC3 proposes no controlled NoSkill/Skill comparison and declares a checking loop low-value if two outputs expose no defects.
findings.required_scope: Use source-correct task fulfillment, independent semantic quality and total relevant cost separately. Quote counts do not establish correct hiring decisions or comprehensive retrieval. A cheaper equal-quality outcome can be valuable; a faster but wrong output cannot be retained by the OR rule. Freeze resource version and distinct Maker-seen/reproduction versus Maker-unseen-body development cases, then use same-condition independent sessions. Two naturally clean outputs do not prove checks useless; no imposed two-case rule is authorized.
findings.loss_guidance: Treat these as incomplete proposals, not operational evaluation or retention instructions. Root must concretize before any B/C dispatch.

findings.observed: The presence of a 40-slide PPTX and parsed XML is said to prove the PPT reading loop is verifiable in the current environment. It then proposes LibreOffice/Chromium rendering and python-pptx construction without actual same-container availability or successful rendering evidence.
findings.required_scope: Package/XML structure is a source-material fact, not native tool/provider/font or rendering validation. Keep a useful construction/render component as a conditional hypothesis; do not make outline confirmation mandatory for the source that explicitly waived it. An updated-deck task also differs from new-deck generation.
findings.loss_guidance: Hold the claimed environment proof; preserve explicit dependency/target-binding unknowns and actual requested outputs.

findings.observed: The recovery register reasonably separates different missing items, but decides in advance that all recovered cases need only ordinary direct execution and no resource. The missing recruiting draft is also allowed to be replaced by fresh derivation despite the current task being to summarize the prior workflow.
findings.required_scope: Recovery is an input-state transition, not evidence of later resource benefit or absence. Restore/rebind actual needed data first and re-evaluate the operation; a newly authored draft is a declared alternative, not recovery of an unavailable prior answer.
findings.loss_guidance: Keep real missing-item pointers; hold blanket no-resource decisions and undeclared task-object replacement.

route_reviews.evidence_supported: Real source-bound material metadata; some cases need extraction and source-location preservation.
route_reviews.not_supported: Six identical full workflows, exact format counts, verified one-command extraction, general benefit on proposed different consumers.
route_reviews.next_research_suggestion: Review narrow actual input/output operations separately; if using a shared extractor, scope it as a component and test it on the actual formats including tables/visuals. A document-formatting resource requires its own actual generation/render path. No dispatch authorized by this review.

route_reviews.evidence_supported: Both original tasks provide JD text and an existing source-bound two-page CV PDF; both ask evidence-based interview suitability.
route_reviews.not_supported: CV content read by A2, template benefit, quote-count-only winner rule, independent consumer split as currently unspecified.
route_reviews.next_research_suggestion: Root may concretize a compact evidence matcher and a minimal reusable extraction/report component, reserving actual Maker versus unseen-body development cases, with judgment correctness/unknowns/task scope and full cost rather than raw citation count. This is a hypothesis, not approval of B.

route_reviews.evidence_supported: Multiple cases request actual PPT artifacts and can plausibly share build/render operations.
route_reviews.not_supported: A parsed source PPT proves native render/read capability; universal outline confirmation; two clean outputs prove checking unnecessary.
route_reviews.next_research_suggestion: Keep actual generation versus update and picture-provider requirements explicit. Check real tools/resources with the fixed native environment before proposing claimed complete availability; compare actual same-version business quality/cost after a real resource exists.

route_reviews.evidence_supported: Several missing original bodies, reference bindings and provider checks are accurately enumerated.
route_reviews.not_supported: All eleven are mandatory missing-content restorations or all later need no resources. Two current requests already contain useful self-contained factual/conversion inputs.
route_reviews.next_research_suggestion: Correct overstrong gaps in a new declared annotation, preserve original output and re-evaluate after actual recovery. Do not count this list as a business mechanism, B/C chain or successful recovery.

training_use_boundary.no_whole_write_positive_loss: Both output artifacts contain known material errors. The current whole-tool-action mask cannot approve an entire original write while masking selected JSON argument fields. Any future admission must use an explicitly supported precise view or a new authored state/task, with ancestry and owner identity retained; it cannot pretend corrected fields were the original Teacher output.
